# EVA Entertainment

> Dubbing, voice-over, Foley, mixing, subtitling, song recording and translation studio in Andheri West, Mumbai. Lip-sync dubbing of films and series into Hindi and other Indian languages.

## Dubbing
- [Lip-Sync Dubbing Studio in Mumbai](https://evaentertainment.in/dubbing-studio): film and series dubbing into Hindi and other Indian languages
- [Hollywood Movies Dubbing](https://evaentertainment.in/dubbing-studio/hollywood)
- [Bollywood Movies Dubbing](https://evaentertainment.in/dubbing-studio/bollywood)
- [Kollywood and Tamil Film Dubbing](https://evaentertainment.in/dubbing-studio/kollywood)
- [Web Series and OTT Dubbing Services](https://evaentertainment.in/dubbing-studio/web-series-ott): episode by episode lip-sync dubbing for web series and OTT shows
- [Animation and Cartoon Dubbing in Hindi](https://evaentertainment.in/dubbing-studio/animation): character voice casting and lip-sync dubbing for animated films
- [Hollywood dubbing for distributors](https://evaentertainment.in/hollywood-dubbing-indian-languages)
- [Pan-India film dubbing](https://evaentertainment.in/pan-india-film-dubbing)
- [Regional film dubbing](https://evaentertainment.in/regional-film-dubbing)
